/*


Main function:
Trisection1  - returns a vector with all posible trisection divisors of a divisor D of weight one
in the curve y^2=f(x) over F_p^d.

f define the curve y^2=f(x) over GF(p,d);
f should be a monic degree 5 polynomial with the Coefficient(f,4)=0.
D a divisor of weight one in the curve  y^2=f(x) over GF(p,d);


Setup:
GF(p,d);
P<x>:=PolynomialRing(F);
J:=Jacobian(HyperellipticCurve(f));
load "trisection1AAECC.txt";
Trisection1(D,f);
*/


Trisection1:=function(D,f)
if Degree(f) ne 5 then print "error" ; end if;
if Coefficient(f,4) ne 0 then print "error"; end if;
R<c2,a0,c1>:=PolynomialRing(F,3);
u3:=D[1];
v3:=D[2];
u30:= Coefficient(u3,0); 
v30:= Coefficient(v3,0);
f3:=Coefficient(f,3);
f2:=Coefficient(f,2);
f1:=Coefficient(f,1);
f0:=Coefficient(f,0); 

E2:=-135*c1*c2^2*u30^2+54*v30*a0*c2^2+6*c1*c2^4*a0+180*c1*c2^2*a0*u30+48*c2*a0*u30*f3+108*c2^3*u30^2*a0-54*c1*c2^2*a0^2+12*c1*a0*u30^2+48*c2*a0*u30^3+54*c2*u30*f2-9*c2*a0^2*u30^2-21*c2*u30^2*f3-21*c2*a0^2*f3-6*c2^3*u30*f3-21*c1*c2^4*u30+3*c1*a0^2*u30+24*c2^5*u30*a0-54*u30*v30*c2^2+72*c2*c1^2*a0-78*c2^3*u30*a0^2-54*c2*a0*f2-18*c1*c2^2*f3-9*c1*u30*f3-90*c2*c1^2*u30+4*c2*a0^3*u30+12*a0*c2^3*f3+18*c1*a0*f3-27*c1^3+12*a0^3*c2^3-3*a0^2*c2^5-27*c2*f1-21*c2^5*u30^2-2*c2^7*u30-35*c2*u30^4-3*c2*a0^4-36*c2^3*u30^3+9*c2*f3^2-3*c2^5*f3+4*c1*a0^3-14*c1*u30^3+27*c1*f2+c1*c2^6;


E3:=648*a0*f3^2*c2^2-3888*v30*a0^2*c2^3+3888*v30*a0*c2^5-3888*v30*c2^5*u30+972*v30*c2^3*u30^2+162*a0^2*u30*f2+648*c2^4*f3^2+5388*a0*u30^2*c2^6+60*a0^2*u30^4+378*a0^2*u30^2*f3+(810*a0^2*c2^2+1620*a0*c2^2*u30-81*a0^2*u30+297*c2^6-1458*c2^2*f3+378*u30^3+1134*a0*c2^4-3969*c2^4*u30-486*a0*f3+243*u30*f3-2835*c2^2*u30^2-324*a0*u30^2-108*a0^3-729*f2)*c1^2+(7290*v30*a0*c2^2+72*c2^7*a0-972*c2*a0*u30*f3+324*c2^3*u30^2*a0-792*c2*a0*u30^3-972*c2*u30*f2+351*c2*a0^2*u30^2+243*c2*u30^2*f3+729*c2*a0^2*f3+162*c2^3*u30*f3+8964*c2^5*u30*a0-7290*u30*v30*c2^2-1134*c2^3*u30*a0^2+486*c2*a0*f2-36*c2*a0^3*u30+1620*a0*c2^3*f3-972*a0^3*c2^3-945*a0^2*c2^5-729*c2*f1-7749*c2^5*u30^2-1440*c2^7*u30+315*c2*u30^4+207*c2*a0^4+3402*c2^3*u30^3+243*c2*f3^2-1377*c2^5*f3)*c1+486*c2^2*f1*u30-1944*c2^4*f1+648*a0*u30^2*f2+1572*a0^2*u30^3*c2^2-1776*a0*u30^3*c2^4+729*f2^2-756*f2*u30^3-810*u30*f3^2*c2^2-5640*a0*u30^4*c2^2-288*a0^3*f3*c2^2-288*u30^3*f3*c2^2+684*a0*f3*c2^6-720*a0*f3*u30^3-864*a0^2*f3*c2^4+36*a0^3*f3*u30-702*u30^2*f3*c2^4+972*a0*f3*f2-180*u30*f3*c2^6-486*u30*f3*f2-324*a0*f3^2*u30-336*a0^3*u30^2*c2^2+1170*a0^2*u30^2*c2^4-5076*a0*f3*c2^2*u30^2+2214*a0^2*f3*c2^2*u30+1512*a0*f3*c2^4*u30+6156*f2*a0*c2^2*u30+324*a0^2*f3^2+144*a0^4*f3+81*u30^2*f3^2+252*u30^4*f3-2916*v30^2*c2^2+105*a0^4*u30^2-40*a0^3*u30^3-336*a0*u30^5-147*c2^4*u30^4-1353*c2^8*u30^2+906*c2^2*u30^5-1120*c2^6*u30^3+104*a0^3*c2^6+216*a0^3*f2+24*a0^5*u30-48*a0^5*c2^2+312*a0^4*c2^4-270*c2^6*f2-120*c2^8*a0^2+60*c2^10*a0-210*c2^10*u30-180*c2^8*f3+16*a0^6-11*c2^12+196*u30^6-1782*c2^2*u30^2*f2+2916*v30*a0*c2^3*u30+246*a0^4*c2^2*u30+276*a0^3*c2^4*u30-3972*c2^6*a0^2*u30+1596*c2^8*a0*u30-1296*f2*a0^2*c2^2-2268*f2*a0*c2^4+2106*f2*c2^4*u30+972*f2*c2^2*f3-3888*c2^2*a0*f1;

E4:=4536*c2^2*a0^2*u30*f2+378*u30^3*a0^2*f3-2916*c2*u30*v30*f2+648*u30^3*a0*f2+4356*c2^2*a0*f3*u30^3+288*c2^2*a0^3*f3*u30+972*c2^2*u30*f3*f2-216*c2^2*a0*f3^2*u30+432*c2^4*a0*f3^2+3240*c2^5*v30*a0^2-4536*c2^3*v30*a0^3+1620*c2^4*a0^3*u30^2+60*c2^6*a0^2*u30^2+864*c2^6*f1-32*c2^8*a0^3+81*u30^3*f3^2+252*u30^5*f3+2916*c2^2*u30*v30^2+1056*c2^4*a0^4*u30-1560*c2^6*a0^3*u30+2712*c2^8*a0^2*u30-612*c2^10*a0*u30-1998*c2^6*f2*u30-2268*c2^7*v30*a0+432*c2*v30*a0^4-5832*c2^2*v30^2*a0+2268*c2^7*v30*u30-3240*c2^3*v30*u30^3-324*c2^5*v30*u30^2-3396*c2^8*a0*u30^2-4608*c2^2*a0^2*u30^4-10446*c2^4*a0^2*u30^3+3468*c2^6*a0*u30^3+4050*c2^2*f2*u30^3+432*c2^4*u30*f3^2+13008*c2^4*a0*u30^4+1728*c2^6*a0*f2-1944*c2^4*f1*u30-2430*c2^2*f1*u30^2+6696*c2^4*a0*f3*u30^2-3024*c2^4*a0^2*f3*u30-852*c2^6*a0*f3*u30+1944*c2*v30*a0^2*f3-2268*c2^4*f2*a0*u30+648*c2^3*v30*a0*u30^2+972*c2*v30*a0^2*u30^2-2916*c2^5*v30*a0*u30+1944*c2^2*f1*u30*a0+162*u30^2*a0^2*f2-720*u30^4*a0*f3+36*u30^2*a0^3*f3-486*u30^2*f3*f2-324*u30^2*a0*f3^2-4*c2^14+1512*c2*u30^4*v30+60*u30^5*a0^2-108*c2^2*a0^2*f3^2+36*c2^2*a0^4*f3+702*c2^2*u30^2*f3^2-1980*c2^2*u30^4*f3-354*c2^2*a0^4*u30^2+304*c2^2*a0^3*u30^3+4704*c2^2*a0*u30^5-144*c2^2*a0^5*u30+2106*c2^4*u30^2*f2-2916*c2^2*a0^2*f1+729*u30*f2^2-756*u30^4*f2-5238*c2^2*a0^2*u30^2*f3-5508*c2^2*a0*u30^2*f2+324*u30*a0^2*f3^2+144*u30*a0^4*f3+216*u30*a0^3*f2+972*c2*u30^2*f3*v30-396*c2^6*f3^2-1680*c2^6*u30^4+582*c2^10*u30^2-4851*c2^4*u30^5+439*c2^8*u30^3+(1008*c2^7*f3-16038*c2^2*v30*a0*u30+5076*c2^3*a0*u30*f3+486*c2*u30*f2*a0-972*c2*u30^2*a0*f3+729*c2*u30*a0^2*f3-3269*c2^5*u30^3-729*u30*c2*f1+243*u30*c2*f3^2+243*c2*u30^3*f3+432*c2^3*a0^2*f3-3726*c2^3*a0^2*u30^2-36*c2*u30^2*a0^3+8262*c2^2*u30^2*v30-972*c2*u30^2*f2-225*c2^5*u30*f3+16452*c2^3*a0*u30^3-5886*c2^3*u30^2*f3+207*c2*u30*a0^4-792*c2*u30^4*a0+384*c2^9*a0-2124*c2^3*a0^3*u30+3888*c2^4*v30*u30-5688*c2^7*u30*a0-1788*c2^5*u30^2*a0+351*c2*u30^3*a0^2+3279*c2^5*u30*a0^2+7776*c2^2*v30*a0^2-2304*c2^5*a0*f3-3888*c2^4*v30*a0-104*c2^11-864*f2*c2^5-648*c2^3*f3^2+ 173564379072*c2^4*u30^2*f3^5*f2^2-334731302496*c2^4*u30^2*f3^3*f2^2*f1+669462604992*c2^4*u30*v30^2*f3^3*f2^2-4132485216*c2^4*u30*f3^7*f2+6198727824*c2^4*f3^6*f2^2;



//R1b:=r1 div c2^4;
//R2b:=r2 div c2^4


//R3b:=r3 div c2^4;

R1b:=r1;
R2b:=r2;
R3b:=r3;

T1:=Resultant(R1b,R2b,a0);
T2:=Resultant(R1b,R3b,a0);

Degree(T1,c2);
Degree(T2,c2);
G:=GCD(T1,T2);
Degree(G,c2);

S:=SquarefreeFactorization(G);
S;
T:=S[1][1];
RT:=Roots(UnivariatePolynomial(T));
counter:=0;
V:=[J!0:i in [1..#RT]];
for i:=1 to #RT do
C2:=RT[i][1];
print "C2";
C2;   
T1a:=Evaluate(r1,1,C2);
T2a:=Evaluate(r2,1,C2);
T3a:=Evaluate(r3,1,C2);


RC:=Roots(UnivariatePolynomial(GCD(GCD(T1a,T2a),T3a)));
for j:=1 to #RC do
A0:=RC[j][1];
print "A0";
A0;
E2a:=Evaluate(E2,1,C2);
E3a:=Evaluate(E3,1,C2);
E4a:=Evaluate(E4,1,C2);
E2b:=Evaluate(E2a,2,A0);
E3b:=Evaluate(E3a,2,A0);
E4b:=Evaluate(E4a,2,A0);
RA:=Roots(UnivariatePolynomial(GCD(GCD(E2b,E3b),E4b)));
for l:=1 to #RA do
print "C1";
C1:=RA[l][1];
C1;



U11:=-(1/3)*C2^2-(1/3)*u30+(2/3)*A0;

U10:=-(5/9)*C2^2*u30-(2/3)*C2*C1-(2/9)*A0*u30+(2/9)*u30^2+(1/3)*f3-(1/9)*A0^2-(1/9)*C2^4+(4/9)*C2^2*A0;

C0:=(-5*C2^6+27*f2-54*v30*C2+3*A0^2*u30-9*u30*f3+12*A0*u30^2+18*A0*f3-33*C2^4*u30-36*C2^3*C1-15*C2^2*u30^2+18*C2^2*f3-42*C2^2*A0^2+30*C2^4*A0+72*A0*C2*C1-14*u30^3-90*C2*C1*u30+60*C2^2*A0*u30-27*C1^2+4*A0^3)/(54*C2);

print "C0";
C0;

C:=C2*x^2+C1*x+C0 ;
A:=x+A0;
U1:=x^2+U11*x+U10;
B:=u3*C+A*v3;
d,s,t:=XGCD(A,U1); 
V1:=-s*B mod U1;
V[i]:= J![x^2+U11*x+U10,V1];
counter:=counter+1;
 end for;
end for;
end for;
print counter ;
return V;
end function;
